```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(opectools)
res <- run_analysis(params$config)
fmt <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  num <- vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))
  x[num] <- lapply(x[num], function(v) signif(v, digits))
  knitr::kable(x)
}
section <- function(title, x, digits = 3) {
  if (is.null(x) || !nrow(as.data.frame(x))) return(invisible())
  cat("\n\n####", title, "\n\n")
  print(fmt(x, digits))
}
```

**Project:** `r res$config$project`
**Configuration:** `r basename(res$config$.config_path)`
**Package version:** opectools `r as.character(utils::packageVersion("opectools"))`

## Data quality checks

```{r qa}
fmt(res$qa)
```

Collection methods are analysed separately and are never pooled for inference.

```{r analyses, results = "asis", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5}
for (a in res$analyses) {
  cat("\n\n## Analysis:", a$name, "\n\n")
  cat("Method:", paste(unlist(a$config$method), collapse = ", "),
      "| Sampling unit:", paste(unlist(a$config$sampling_unit), collapse = " x "),
      "| Units analysed:", nrow(a$units), "\n\n")
  section("Analysis-specific QA", a$qa)
  section("Species composition", a$composition)
  section("Diversity", a$diversity)
  section("Catch summary by group", a$summary_groups)
  print(a$trend_plot)

  cat("\n\n### Model comparison\n\n")
  cat("Information criteria are shown only for models that converged with a",
      "positive-definite Hessian. AIC guides, but does not replace, the",
      "analyst's choice of primary model.\n\n")
  print(fmt(a$comparison[, c("model", "family", "zi", "n", "converged",
                             "pd_hessian", "df", "logLik", "AIC", "delta_AIC", "note")]))
  section("Likelihood-ratio tests", a$lrt)
  section("Simulation-based residual diagnostics (DHARMa)",
          a$diagnostics[, intersect(c("model", "test", "statistic", "p_value"),
                                    names(a$diagnostics))])
  if (nrow(a$warnings)) section("Fitting warnings", a$warnings)

  if (is.null(a$primary)) {
    cat("\n\n> **No primary model designated.** Review the comparison and",
        "diagnostics above, then set `primary:` in the configuration.\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("\n\n### Primary model:", a$primary, "\n\n")
    cat("`", deparse1(a$fits[[a$primary]]$formula), "`\n\n")
    if (!is.null(a$fits[[a$primary]]$spec$zi)) cat("Zero-inflation: `", a$fits[[a$primary]]$spec$zi, "`\n\n")
    section("Coefficients (exponentiated = rate ratios / odds ratios)",
            a$coefficients[a$coefficients$model == a$primary, -1])
    section("Estimated marginal means", a$means)
    section("Contrasts", a$contrasts)
    section("Rate ratios for continuous predictors", a$rate_ratios)
    section("Collinearity (adjusted GVIF)", a$vif)
  }
  section("Descriptive correlations (period level)", a$correlations)
  section("Exploratory lagged regressions", a$lag_regressions)
}
```
